result.reason: All 20 obligations are assessed from supplied NL contracts, exact source inventory, canonical IR, inspection-equivalent and verify facts, and closed FCSTM model binding. Containment, transition-endpoint, reachability and termination obligations are established as violated by exact inventories showing missing exit_urban, missing transitions, unreachable CollisionAvoidanceSystem from root initial [*]->AutonomousMode, and FinishState first-mention nesting with continuing ancestors. Guard obligations are established as violated because bound transition carriers are observed with guard=null while NL contracts require specific independent guards.
